Context
-------
Read .github/copilot-instructions.md first — the learner-vm
conventions appended by prompt 10s apply (scripts are artifacts;
execution evidence only via feedback/ transcriptions; SCRIPT_VERSION
bumps; report block protocol).

NOTE: the content artifacts (content/repos, content/docs,
content/extracted, content/bin) are produced by prompt 10s. This
prompt does NOT create them — 00-diagnose CHECKS their presence.

Environment model (fixed facts — do not re-litigate)
----------------------------------------------------
- Target: RHEL 8.6 MINIMAL base image. Desktop, Firefox and container
  tooling are installed BY THESE SCRIPTS (10-80, later prompts), not
  assumed present.
- The base image already has: the self-signed airgap CA in the OS
  trust store; DNF repos pointing at Artifactory (BaseOS, AppStream,
  EPEL); fixed hostname and network configured by the image team.
- Container runtime: PODMAN ONLY, ROOTFUL. No docker-ce repo access,
  no docker daemon. `docker` on the VM is the podman-docker shim (RPM,
  installed by script 20). docker-compose v2 is the vendored binary
  from prompt 10s (installed by script 50). Compose is robustness
  only — zero usage in any lab.
- Auto-elevate wrappers (script 50) make plain `docker`/`podman`
  equivalent to sudo-prefixed, so lab commands hit ONE rootful image
  store — the one the preloaded images live in. This REQUIRES
  passwordless sudo for the engineer user.
- User: engineer (exists, wheel member). sudo currently prompts for a
  password; script 50 makes it passwordless because the wrappers
  require non-interactive sudo.
- Pulls are ANONYMOUS — confirmed. There is no podman login step. If
  a probe ever returns 401, that is a design change to escalate, not
  a bug to work around.
- Registry: all container upstreams (docker.io, ghcr.io, quay.io) are
  proxied through ONE endpoint:
      $DOCKER_REGISTRY = "${ART_HOST}/artifactory/docker-registry"
  Routing is BY IMAGE PATH ONLY. Podman registries.conf MIRRORS route
  pulls of original references here transparently and store them
  under the ORIGINAL name. There is NO retagging and NO in-VM
  registry anywhere in this design.
- CA trust locations: the OS store (/etc/pki/ca-trust) — already
  configured on the base; and /etc/containers/certs.d/$REG_HOST/
  ca.crt — installed by script 30. /etc/docker does NOT exist in this
  design. Any /etc/docker reference anywhere in this repo is a bug.

Objective
---------
Produce the foundation artifacts:
  scripts/lib.sh            shared helpers (logging, steps, report)
  scripts/00-diagnose.sh    read-only environment report
  lab-vm.conf               operator-tunable variables
  README-FIRST.md           operator run order + transcription guide

scripts/lib.sh
--------------
Each script sets SCRIPT_NAME and SCRIPT_VERSION before sourcing.
lib.sh provides:

  REPO_ROOT     derived from the sourcing script's own path (two
                levels up from scripts/); fatal with fix-hint if not
                found
  REG_HOST      derived from DOCKER_REGISTRY — the host part before
                the first '/'; validated non-empty and slash-free;
                malformed DOCKER_REGISTRY is fatal with fix-hint
                pointing at lab-vm.conf
  REPOS_ROOT / DOCS_ROOT / VENDOR_BIN
                derived as $REPO_ROOT/content/{repos,docs,bin}.
                Content paths are NEVER operator-configured; they
                follow the repo's own location.
  LOG_DIR       /var/log/lab-setup; created on first write

  log "msg"     "[<SCRIPT_NAME>] msg" to stdout AND
                $LOG_DIR/<SCRIPT_NAME>.log
  step_ok "msg" counts OK; logs with a check mark
  step_skip "reason" "msg"
                counts SKIPPED; logs with an arrow and the reason
  step_fail "what" "fix-hint" ["diagnostic command", ...]
                counts as F<n>; logs with a cross; then runs each
                diagnostic command immediately, capturing up to 15
                lines of combined stdout+stderr into the report entry
                (or records "command not found" / a timeout notice).
                fix-hint must name a file, URL or variable.
  begin_report / end_report "NEXT: ..."
                end_report prints:
                  ==================== REPORT BEGIN ====================
                  SCRIPT: <name> v<version>
                  HOST: <hostname> <UTC timestamp> git: <sha, best effort>
                  RESULT: PASSED|FAILED (ok=N failed=N skipped=N)
                  F1..Fn: what / fix-hint / capped diagnostics
                  OK: N steps — full log: <path>
                  SKIPPED: itemised reasons
                  NEXT: <supplied line>
                  ==================== REPORT END ======================
                Block must stay <=60 lines and contain NO ANSI colour.
                Colour outside the block is permitted.
  run "cmd..."  executes via bash -c, honouring the script's --dry-run
                flag: in dry-run, print "[dry-run] WOULD: <cmd>" and
                return 0 without executing
  require_or_skip "binary" "description"
                if the binary is absent: step_skip and return 1 so the
                caller can branch

scripts/00-diagnose.sh   SCRIPT_VERSION = 3
------------------------------------------
READ-ONLY. ALWAYS exits 0. Designed to run FIRST, on the just-installed
minimal base — every check degrades to step_skip with a reason if the
underlying tool is absent. No --dry-run needed (it changes nothing).

Checks, in order:

 1. System: /etc/redhat-release, uname -m, hostname, primary IPv4
    (hostname -I), memory (free -g), disk free on / AND on /var/lib
    (podman storage lives under /var/lib/containers)
 2. User model: id engineer — exists? wheel member? sudoers state:
    grep NOPASSWD for engineer across /etc/sudoers and
    /etc/sudoers.d/* — expected ABSENT at this stage; report as an
    arrow-expected line: "script 50 will configure passwordless sudo;
    the auto-elevate wrappers require it". visudo present?
 3. ISO: ISO_PATH from lab-vm.conf. If a device (/dev/cdrom, /dev/sr0):
    mount, verify BaseOS/ and AppStream/ exist, unmount. If a file:
    loop-mount read-only to a temp dir, same check, unmount. Report
    which form was found. SKIPPED with reason if neither works.
 4. Artifactory + registry probes (curl, 10s timeouts, using the OS
    trust store — NEVER --insecure):
      https://$ART_HOST/                       expect 200 or 302
      https://$DOCKER_REGISTRY/v2/             report the code
      manifest GETs with Accept:
      application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json, for:
        $DOCKER_REGISTRY/v2/library/busybox/manifests/1.36
        $DOCKER_REGISTRY/v2/fluent/fluent-bit/manifests/5.1.1
        $DOCKER_REGISTRY/v2/prometheus/node-exporter/manifests/v1.12.1
      (tags per recon; the committed parse-labs output —
      content/extracted/external-images.txt — is the final authority;
      if it lists different tags, probe those too and note the
      discrepancy)
    Interpret the codes:
      200 -> reachable
      401 -> "registry requires authentication — pulls were confirmed
              anonymous; escalate to the Artifactory admin; this is a
              design change"
      404 -> "image not cached and pull-through did not fetch, or the
              repo path is wrong — confirm DOCKER_REGISTRY with the
              admin; the image must be warm before script 60"
    On any failure, auto-diagnostics: getent hosts $ART_HOST;
    curl -v tail (10 lines); openssl s_client -connect <REG_HOST>:443
    </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer;
    AND a fallback probe of https://$ART_HOST/v2/<same path> — the
    root endpoint served pulls successfully in earlier testing, so a
    root-vs-docker-registry discrepancy is diagnostic gold.
 5. DNF: dnf repolist; dnf module list container-tools (stream state);
    dnf makecache timed — report duration; on failure include the last
    20 lines of `dnf -v makecache`.
    NOTE: docker-ce repo probing is DELIBERATELY ABSENT — docker-ce is
    not part of this design.
 6. CA trust:
      ls /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ (count + names)
      bundle subject count via openssl (best effort) + grep for the
      airgap CA subject
      /etc/containers/certs.d/$REG_HOST/ca.crt — expected ABSENT at
      this stage (script 30 installs it); arrow-expected line, NOT a
      failure
 7. Proxy env: HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, NO_PROXY and the lowercase
    variants — report which are set
 8. Container tooling:
      command -v docker — if present, readlink -f it. A REAL docker
      daemon binary/server is UNEXPECTED and must be flagged loudly
      (it would mean a second runtime).
      rpm -q podman-docker — expected ABSENT at this stage (script 20
      installs it)
      podman / buildah / skopeo versions, or SKIPPED with reason
      if podman is present: podman info exit status (stderr tail on
      failure); head -20 of /etc/containers/registries.conf — script
      40 replaces this file wholesale; the stock state is context
 9. Podman services + kernel: systemctl is-active podman.socket
    (expected inactive now); sysctl -n vm.max_map_count (stock 65530;
    the OpenSearch lab needs 262144 — script 40 sets it)
10. Content:
      REPO_ROOT exists
      content/repos/<track> for all five tracks, with lab*.html
      counts per track
      content/docs/<track> landing page per track
      content/bin/docker-compose-v2 exists AND its sha256 matches
      content/bin/docker-compose-v2.sha256 — mismatch is a FAILURE
      content/extracted/{commands.json, external-images.txt,
      curated.json} present? If MISSING: arrow line "produced by
      prompt 10s on the online side — the transfer is incomplete
      without them; script 60 consumes commands.json"
11. Host state: getenforce; firewalld is-active; systemctl
    get-default; is gdm installed? (expected absent — the base is
    minimal; script 20 installs the GUI)

Output: one [00-diagnose] line per check, tick/cross/arrow convention;
the same stream written to $LOG_DIR/00-diagnose.log.
end_report NEXT line:
  "transcribe this report block; provisioning scripts (10-80) are
   finalised after this report is reviewed"

Modes:
  (default)   run all checks
  --selftest  render a synthetic report block (2 OK, 1 FAILED WITH
              diagnostics, 1 SKIPPED) with zero system access. This is
              the agent's execution evidence — the agent runs it
              online.

lab-vm.conf
-----------
Operator-tunable values ONLY. Every path under content/ is derived by
lib.sh from the repo's own location — do not add path variables here.

  HOSTNAME="o11y-lab.internal"
  STATIC_IP=""              # empty = keep the base image's network
                            # config; set "a.b.c.d/24" only if needed
  ART_HOST="artifactory.internal"
  DOCKER_REGISTRY="${ART_HOST}/artifactory/docker-registry"
  ART_HOST_IP=""            # if set, script 30 writes an /etc/hosts
                            # entry — removes DNS as a failure class
  CA_CERT_SOURCE="/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/airgap-ca.crt"
  ISO_PATH="/dev/cdrom"     # device or file path; empty = ISO
                            # fallback disabled
  WORKSHOP_USER="engineer"
  PASSWORDLESS_SUDO="yes"   # REQUIRED — script 50's auto-elevate
                            # wrappers need non-interactive sudo;
                            # "no" is fatal there
  AUTOLOGIN="yes"
  BROWSER="firefox"

NOTE: there is NO docker-ce, daemon, or content-path variable in this
file. If a previous version carried DNF_DOCKER_CE_BASEURL or
CONTENT_ROOT, they are REMOVED — do not bring them forward.

README-FIRST.md
---------------
One page:
- what this repo is (offline learner VM provisioning; podman runtime
  via the podman-docker shim, rootful, auto-elevated; Artifactory
  single-endpoint registry; fully pre-loaded guarantee — no runtime
  pulls, ever)
- transfer the repo to the VM; edit lab-vm.conf ONLY for values that
  differ from the defaults
- run order (operator, sudo):
    00-diagnose -> 10-preflight -> 20-install-tooling ->
    30-ca-and-trust -> 40-podman-config -> 50-user-setup ->
    60-load-images -> 70-quickstart -> 80-verify-offline -> snapshot
- the transcription protocol with one example REPORT block; the rule
  "transcribe, do not improvise"; every script is idempotent — re-runs
  are always safe; if a script fails, transcribe and STOP
- feedback/airgap-run-00N.md naming convention for the online side
- the snapshot instruction: once 80-verify-offline passes, shut the VM
  down cleanly and snapshot — that snapshot is the shipped artifact

Validation (agent-side, online — the ONLY execution claims allowed)
-------------------------------------------------------------------
- bash -n on every script; shellcheck with errors fatal, warnings
  allowed
- run scripts/00-diagnose.sh --selftest and paste the rendered block
- grep audits — ALL must return zero matches across scripts/ and
  lab-vm.conf:
      grep -rn "docker-ce" scripts/ lab-vm.conf
      grep -rn "/etc/docker" scripts/
      grep -rn "daemon.json" scripts/
      grep -rn "registry-mirrors" scripts/
- confirm lib.sh's REG_HOST validation fails loudly on a malformed
  DOCKER_REGISTRY (paste the failure output)

Acceptance
----------
1. bash -n + shellcheck results for lib.sh and 00-diagnose.sh.
2. The --selftest rendered block pasted: <=60 lines, no colour codes,
   contains F1 with at least one diagnostic output and one SKIPPED.
3. The grep audit results pasted — all zero matches.
4. lab-vm.conf and README-FIRST.md pasted in full for review.
5. Explicit statement: no learner-vm script was executed against the
   VM; the only execution was 00-diagnose.sh --selftest (online).
